newsitem.title: USA: Mikohn wins largest CasinoLink contract.
newsitem.headline: Mikohn wins largest CasinoLink contract.

text.p: Mikohn Gaming Corp Monday said it has won a $1.8 million order to install its CasinoLink slot machine information and management system in Canada, making it the largest order received to date for the system. In a statement, Mikohn said CasinoLink will be the central management system for slot machines operated by charitable groups in British Columbia. The contract was awarded by the British Columbia Lottery Corp (BCLC).
The agreement calls for CasinoLink to be installed during October on 1,300 slot machines. Over the next six to 18 months, BCLC expects to add roughly 4,000 slot machines to the system.
